visibility.updates: existing active project check-ins and material milestones

lanes.result: One exact owner 24-joint motion-only take had true toe flex but failed physical planted load. Separate static probe clears left flat load, not either toe-roll pose. No art/normal gameplay or two-handed grip approval.
lanes.next: Choose a materially distinct legal planted-trajectory support case before authoring any further clip. No new boot edit.

lanes.result: The separate disposable pine save copy earned one wood and restored without replay. The previous version's scripts still read its preserved original copy. Separate carry visuals remain unverified.
lanes.next: Use the isolated profile procedure for testing only. Production save adoption still needs a compatibility plan; independently validate the carry mounts.

lanes.result: Shaped owner-reference V4 gates passed 78 isolated desktop checks and 16 exact frames. Art remains below 9.5: South 9.3 and East 9.2. One southwest front fence panel with Meshy grain passed 67 isolated checks and scored 9.1. Lower-rope V4 scored 9.0 and was rejected; keep textured V3 as the best unapproved draft.
lanes.next: Compare one exact paid V4/V5 gate frame before any later full route. No full fence, rear, phone or installation approval. The funded pre-purchase plot at normal camera remains unverified.

lanes.result: 47 Level 1 scenarios scoped. The isolated Godot audio player passed 131 checks across four modes without exit leaks. This verifies player behavior, not audible playback or installed game audio.
lanes.next: Stage a clearly opt-in listening preview; verify audible playback and device mix before any integration.

lanes.result: The isolated native test reached both standing positions. The independent review reproduced obstruction on all 16 straight hand-to-marker paths tested. This does not rule out an authored reach animation.
lanes.next: Compare a separately staged approach or reachable handling target before any serving integration. Customer and payment behavior remain out of this test.

lanes.result: The authentic concept exists and is pinned. The scoped custody check found no matching runtime model, rig, or encounter. Fish remain outside Level 1.
lanes.next: Admit a source-matched detached asset before any dependent motion or encounter work.

office_events.message: Handoff summary: The independently reproduced overlaps span the boots, knees, and hems. The current pose stays rejected; one same-look detached rebuild is the next test.
Handoff summary: The three original starter pickups were verified as separate committed sources. The current grouped carry display stayed unchanged; it cannot trigger the purchase sweep.
Handoff summary: The first detached garment rebuild failed with six overlaps at rest. Keep it out of the game and verify any revised garment at rest before testing gait.
Handoff summary: The stock bundle cannot show three individual arrivals. Keep purchase logic independent and test real per-log carry slots before adding the deck effect.
Handoff summary: The six seam changes are clear at rest. Keep the patch detached; small probe displacements exposed folds and no actual gait has passed.
Handoff summary: Both counter stances are reachable, but the tested straight hand paths are blocked. Do not treat the current markers as usable for serving.
Handoff summary: The original collar crossing cleared, but new neighboring overlaps and a remaining fold prevent approval. Keep the playable character unchanged.
Handoff summary: The first eligible repeat cut earned one wood. Older save code safely refused the newer payload; keep the change detached pending a compatibility plan.
Handoff summary: The entire detached route passed its 67 functional checks. Use the same exact revision for visual proof; do not call this a full Level 1 release.
Handoff summary: The detached opening and reload ran at the stock game camera. The original wall and gate visuals are placeholders and still need art review.
Runtime passed; visual review held on flat placeholder gate leaves and near-black timber. Keep fixes separate from original gate mechanisms.
The fence winding correction preserved the known gameplay route. Improve shadow readability and reference detail; the separate timber gate still needs actual full-sweep clearance.
All four authored doors mounted and both gates passed gameplay. Hold art and continue the separately authored reference fence panel; do not reintroduce the old fence as final.
Verified the exact one-panel normal-camera test. Visual 8.6 remains held below the 9.5 standard. Fix readability and snow drape; the rest of the fence in this case is control.
Rebuilt gates pass open and active closure in isolated gameplay, with hard blockers and exact unchanged restore. Art and device remain held.
New owner-reference static gate source is admitted to native import staging only. Preserve original hinges, physical behavior and exact scene scope.
New owner-facing gate assembly passed the exact desktop movement and restore route. Keep correct gate leaves and posts. Visual holds and one-panel fence material test remain separate.
Independent gate art HOLD at 9.2 South and 9.1 East; 78 mechanics checks passed. Keep motion, evaluate the wider front cross-braces separately.
Keep the scoped Meshy grain. Lower front crossings are staged alone on one panel; compare against the previously graded 9.1 panel.
The current 24-joint walk does not plant the boot under load. A viable next exact phase must demonstrate broad, stable physical outsole support; no new clip is admitted yet.
